funding_notes: Verified domain withfulcrum.com (AI agents for insurance brokerages: policy checking, proposals, certificates), HQ San Francisco; co-founders Arjun Mangla (CEO) and Sambhav Anand (CTO). Announced $25M in combined Seed and Series A funding led by CRV with South Park Commons, Foundation Capital and angels (Business Wire/Axios, Jan 27, 2026); the split between seed and Series A was not disclosed. The company blog indicates an earlier seed led by SPC and Foundation Capital, which appears to be included in the $25M combined figure.

Regie.ai (regie.ai), San Francisco; AI sales-prospecting platform founded 2020 by Srinath Sridhar and Matt Millen. $4.8M seed (reported June 2022 by Business Insider), $10M Series A (Sep 2022, Scale Venture Partners lead), $30M Series B (Feb 2025, co-led by Scale VP and Foundation Capital). Sum of sourced rounds $44.8M. TriplePoint Capital participated in the Series B; any venture-debt part isn't broken out.
